description: Contact reports (calls, emails, meetings) logged for a constituent, with type, date, text and team member. LGL: GET /api/v1/constituents/{constituent_id}/contact_reports.

limit.description: Number of entries to return, 1-100. LGL's default is 25.

offset.description: Start at this entry (0-based). Use the previous page's next_item. Default 0.

name: lgl_list_constituent_contact_reports
title: List a constituent's contact reports
